appearance.extreme: Their left hand is a blackened dead thing on the end of a living arm. The rot has reached the elbow and stopped there, for now.
appearance.obvious: Their left hand is dead, grey-black to the wrist, and does not move quite in time with the rest of them.
appearance.subtle: The skin of their left hand is grey and dry.

description: One hand has darkened and hardened. Melee attacks cause bleeding. You can't wear gloves.
name: Necrotic Hand
